settings.title: Tank Settings
settings.description: The refill threshold is used exactly as configured, with median filtering and sustained confirmation. Last known measurements remain visible when the Arduino is offline. Low Water Level controls the warning sensor; Estimation Reserve Level is independent. Ambient correction is an optional trial, not a validated accuracy model. Unavailable or stale weather uses raw depth. Level and volume remain capped at configured capacity.

reset_refill_history.title: Clear Refill Data
reset_refill_history.description: Clear all stored refill events, the last refill amount/time and active refill tracking. Home Assistant Recorder statistics are retained.
